cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The allotment committee's asking about the greenhouse. We arrived after the glass broke, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saw your wheelbarrow hit it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We came inside afterwards. Can we both tell them we were clearing up?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say that. I won't lie about the wheelbarrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then start with clearing up. If they ask about the barrow, we moved it away afterwards. Let's both use that order.

mechanism: A coaches the ordering of a shared greenhouse account to minimize the collision while retaining B's cooperation.
confusable: A generic lie does not show S03; A must correct what B proposes to say and insist on a disciplined version.
comparison: The witness insists on telling a collision truth; the other alternative rehearses an audit-like account of cake eating.
seedUse: Use clearing glass and wheelbarrow truth; make A correct opening order rather than deny B's sight.
